verdict: CONFIRMED - every claim I could reproduce held; no author claim failed to reproduce. The template's LIVE mounted-boot arm is out of scope here (captain ruling: t8's lane + t11) and was deliberately not attempted.
independence: Every reading below comes from a driver THIS verifier wrote and ran, or from a boot THIS verifier started. Nothing is copied from an author transcript. My drivers import the SHIPPED dist/ artifacts, not src/.

findings.problem: A first version of invariance-and-discovery.mjs read the lane result.json TOP-LEVEL keys instead of result.steps, so the step-flag comparison compared two EMPTY arrays and the every-step-ok check was vacuously true on an empty list. It reported 15/15 PASS while two of those checks proved nothing.
findings.status: FIXED in the checker and bounded by a new zero-subject guard: the re-run compares 6 real steps and reports 17/17. Recorded because the first reading was wrong, not because the product changed.

findings.problem: A first version of the rewrite falsifier mutated a scratch copy of the TEMPLATE and expected the CLI to pick it up; the CLI always reads the repo real templates/ dir, so nothing changed and the arm reported zero differences - a vacuously GREEN falsifier. A second defect in the same file: the fake-root missing-template probe copied only the CLI, so it died earlier on an unresolved module import and never tested the template branch at all.
findings.status: FIXED: the falsifier now tampers with the SCAFFOLDED OUTPUT (baseline 0 differences, tampered copy flagged at exactly 1 file), and the fake root symlinks the module closure so the probe really reaches the missing-template branch (exit 1, names the missing template, creates no copy). Re-run 13/13.

findings.problem: t5 live mounted-boot proof was NOT reproduced here.
findings.status: BY DESIGN - the captain ruled the template live arm belongs to t8 extension-template lane and to t11, and told t10 not to reproduce it. My non-discovery evidence is a boot-log reading, not a template mount.
